text:
sara: noticed spike in mTLS failures in eu-west after RBAC tighten deploy; services affected: auth-api -> keystore, ingest -> proxy.
raj: error samples?
sara: auth-api logs: `tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate`. KMS shows Unwrap AccessDenied for ephemeral key.
eli: security-bot also flagged KMS unwrap denies. CLI check: `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/ephemeral-regional` -> grant for role/service-rotator missing.
security-bot: Alert: KMS Unwrap Deny (eu-west-1) — 24 errors in 6m.
maya: PR #5281 narrowed role ARNs; looks like it removed the rotator principal from the allowed set in the key policy.
sara: mitigation plan: create temporary grant scoped to rotator role and eu-west, monitor for 15m, then patch RBAC. Proposed command (audit tag included):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/ephemeral-regional --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/service-rotator --operations Decrypt --name temp-eu-unlock
```
raj: add retiring-principal and a note with incident id. ops-bot: will auto-retire after 20m if tagged `temp=true`.
eli: canary created, handshakes recovering on two pods. 502s dropping.
security-bot: Update: unwrap denies down to 1 in last 5m. Creating incident doc: INCIDENT-2026-04-kms-rbac-unwrap.
sara: follow-ups: 1) add KMS grant reconciliation to RBAC rollout checklist; 2) add CI smoke that rotates certs and asserts KMS Unwrap success in eu and na; 3) author Terraform module to manage grants per-region. Owners: raj=RBAC gating, eli=terraform, maya=incident + alert.
raj: pausing rollout until RBAC PR updated.
